stake: Exactly $1 per placed bet; no quoted-odds filter
volatility: Sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of daily net profit / opening bankroll. Includes every calendar date with a fixture in the matched sample, including dates on which this strategy places no bets. Excludes dates with no fixtures. Not annualized.
roi: Net profit / total stakes; distinct from return on initial $1000 bankroll.
gross_payout: Includes returned winning stakes; net subtracts every stake.
drawdown: Maximum decline from previous daily closing bankroll peak, including initial $1000.
limits: Hypothetical historical Bet365 returns, no costs; outcomes and cutoffs already inspected.
